Reauthorize. The old hold becomes SUPERSEDED and the answer is the NEW hold (new id, new expiry). The scenario of the token is kept, so an expire-early hold is renewed for another five minutes. amountMinor must be positive (422); a hold that is not AUTHORIZED is 409 illegal-transition.
